problem.passage: Economic historians examining the collapse of the Icelandic fishing quota system in the 1980s have focused on an unintended consequence of the reform that was meant to prevent overfishing. Under the new system, the government issued a fixed number of transferable quotas, each granting the holder the right to catch a set amount of fish annually, with the goal of allowing fish populations to recover from decades of unrestricted harvesting. Because these quotas could be bought and sold freely, small-scale fishing operations, which often lacked the capital reserves that larger commercial fleets possessed, found themselves unable to compete when quota prices rose sharply during the reform's first decade. Many small operators, facing years of reduced catch limits and mounting debt, ultimately sold their quotas outright to larger firms rather than continue operating at a loss. As a result, within twenty years of the reform, ownership of fishing rights in Iceland had become ______
problem.stimulus: Economic historians examining the collapse of the Icelandic fishing quota system in the 1980s have focused on an unintended consequence of the reform that was meant to prevent overfishing. Under the new system, the government issued a fixed number of transferable quotas, each granting the holder the right to catch a set amount of fish annually, with the goal of allowing fish populations to recover from decades of unrestricted harvesting. Because these quotas could be bought and sold freely, small-scale fishing operations, which often lacked the capital reserves that larger commercial fleets possessed, found themselves unable to compete when quota prices rose sharply during the reform's first decade. Many small operators, facing years of reduced catch limits and mounting debt, ultimately sold their quotas outright to larger firms rather than continue operating at a loss. As a result, within twenty years of the reform, ownership of fishing rights in Iceland had become ______
problem.question: Which choice most logically completes the text?
options: far more concentrated among a small number of large commercial fishing companies
more evenly distributed across fishing communities than it had been before the reform
entirely dependent on a single company that had purchased all available quotas
largely irrelevant, since fish populations had recovered enough to end the quota system
problem.explanation: 지문은 자본이 부족한 소규모 어업자들이 쿼터 가격 상승과 부채 증가를 견디지 못해 결국 쿼터를 대형 업체에 팔았다고 설명한다. 이 매각이 반복되면서 20년 뒤에는 어업권 소유가 소수의 대형 상업 어선단에 집중되었다는 결론이 가장 논리적이다. A가 이를 정확히 짚는다. B는 지문의 흐름과 정반대로, 소유가 더 고르게 분산되었다고 말한다. C는 '단 하나의 회사'라는 지나친 과장으로 지문이 뒷받침하지 않는 극단적 주장을 한다. D는 어업 자원 회복과 쿼터제 폐지라는, 지문에서 다루지 않은 결과를 제시한다.
problem.explanationEn: The passage explains that undercapitalized small operators, unable to withstand rising quota prices and mounting debt, eventually sold their quotas to larger firms. Given this repeated pattern, the logical conclusion after twenty years is that fishing rights became concentrated among a small number of large commercial companies — choice A. B directly contradicts the passage's trajectory toward consolidation, not wider distribution. C overreaches by claiming a single company owned everything, which the passage does not support. D introduces an unsupported outcome about fish population recovery and the end of the quota system.
problem.evidenceTarget: The reform, though intended to conserve fish stocks, led to the consolidation of fishing rights into the hands of large commercial firms as small operators sold their quotas.
problem.evidenceSpan: Many small operators, facing years of reduced catch limits and mounting debt, ultimately sold their quotas outright to larger firms rather than continue operating at a loss.
problem.answerRationale: 지문은 소규모 어업자들이 결국 쿼터를 대형 업체에 팔았다고 명시하므로, 20년 후 어업권 소유는 대형 업체에 집중되었다는 결론이 자연스럽게 따라온다.

difficultyReasons: 단일 단락의 인과관계(소규모 업체가 쿼터를 팔고 대기업이 사들임)를 따라가면 되는 1단계 추론
정답과 오답 간 공유 정보가 제한적(집중 vs 분산, 단일vs다수, 회복vs소유권)
선택지 B와 D는 지문 내용과 정반대/무관하여 즉시 제거 가능
선택지 C만 정답과 유사한 방향이나 과도한 절대화로 구분 가능

distractors.plausibleBecause: 지문이 개혁의 결과를 다루고 있어 학생이 '분배'라는 단어에 끌릴 수 있음
distractors.whyWrong: 지문은 소규모 어업이 쿼터를 팔고 대기업이 이를 사들였다고 명시하므로 오히려 집중이 심화됨을 보여줌, 분산이 아니라 반대 방향

distractors.plausibleBecause: 대기업으로 집중되었다는 내용과 일부 일치하여 극단적 결론으로 오해할 수 있음
distractors.whyWrong: 지문은 여러 대기업(large commercial fleets)으로의 집중을 말하지, 단일 기업 독점을 명시하지 않음. 과도한 일반화

distractors.plausibleBecause: 개혁의 목적이 어류 자원 회복이었다는 점과 연결하여 성공적 결과로 오해할 수 있음
distractors.matches: 개혁의 목적이 어류 개체수 회복이라는 서술
distractors.whyWrong: 지문은 쿼터 소유권의 집중에 대해 다루고 있으며 어류 개체수 회복이나 쿼터제 폐지에 대한 언급이 전혀 없음, 무관한 결론
